answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 62288 Country: India Title: Saw cats in dream Question: I saw a dream in which my 10 year old daughter brought 5 black pet cats to our home. I felt worried as we could not maintain them. Soon I got awake. Noted time was 3 am the time for tahajjud. Wished to pray but slept back till it was azan for Fajr. Please advise. Answer ID: 62288 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 39/39/M=01/1437) Dream is not a Shariah proof, hence you need not worry. May Allah save all your family from evil. May He keep you firm in iman and following sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
